before.text: Thin hooks in process_manager.rs and async_watcher.rs; output retained per receipt (1 MiB head/tail cap); inline/stdin competing claims. Detailed AC before spawn.

after.text: Wire the B1 CompletionReceiptStore into unified exec without exposing it to the model (final plan sections 5 and 5.1, race table 5.4; verdict rev3 note 8; stage 2a, second leaf of STORY p5-completion-receipts). Thin hooks only: (a) UnifiedExecProcessManager owns one CompletionReceiptStore per runtime generation and reserves a receipt before an opted-in launch, where opt-in is a named internal enum (no bool, no tool-schema change: notify_on_exit exposure is story F); (b) the exec_command initial-response decision calls resolve_initial_response, so an exit that precedes arming is returned inline or retained, never lost or duplicated; (c) spawn_exit_watcher publishes the finalized exit to the receipt only at the point it classifies the terminal event today (after exit, output drain, the network-denial monitor settling and the failure/exit-code/timed-out classification), keeping ExecCommandEnd emission unchanged; (d) retained output per receipt survives removal of the process-store entry on exit, capped at 1 MiB with a head/tail split and an explicit truncation indicator plus omitted-byte count; (e) write_stdin terminal output and the pushed completion share one claim; (f) release, terminate, interrupt and shutdown cancel the receipt with the matching CancellationReason before process termination, and release disarms without killing the process. Slot lifetime (note 8): a Sampled receipt with retained output holds its slot until release or retirement; when all 64 slots are held and at least one is a Sampled receipt with retained output, a new reservation retires the least-recently-sampled receipt's output and reads of it report Retired explicitly; with 64 unsampled receipts the 65th reservation is refused before any process starts. No mailbox, context fragment, tool or prompt change (stories C, D, F).

codex-rs/core/src/unified_exec: process_manager.rs and async_watcher.rs hooks, a new small module for per-receipt retained output (for example receipt_output.rs with sibling *_tests.rs), and completion_receipt.rs only where a hook needs a missing transition (retirement, owner construction). New tests as sibling *_tests.rs files. No tool specs, handlers, session/input_queue, context or app-server changes. Keep each new module under 500 LoC excluding tests.

| # | Requirement | Driving test (production entry) | Negative/refusal |
| - | ----------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| 1 | An opted-in process publishes its exit to the receipt only after exit, output drain, the network-denial monitor and final classification, at the point ExecCommandEnd is emitted; a failure message maps to a failed TerminalCompletion, timed_out is preserved | unified_exec test driving exec_command with the internal opt-in and latches holding the output drain and a deferred denial monitor | while drain or denial is held the receipt is still Armed; a mutant that publishes on exit_token.cancelled() fails this test |
| 2 | Exit around the initial yield (race-table row "exit around initial yield"): exit before the decision returns the terminal result inline and queues nothing; decision before exit queues exactly one completion | test forcing both orders with barriers through exec_command | neither order yields both an inline result and a queued completion; InlineResult frees the slot |
| 3 | Retained output survives removal of the process-store entry on exit and is readable by receipt id; up to 1 MiB is stored verbatim, more is kept as head + tail with truncated=true and the omitted byte count | test producing 3 MiB of output, then reading by receipt after the process entry was removed | retained bytes never exceed the cap; unknown or foreign receipt reads are refused (UnknownReceipt / ForeignOwner) |
| 4 | Slot lifetime: inline delivery, release and owner stop/shutdown free the slot; a Sampled receipt with retained output keeps its slot until release or retirement; with 64 slots held and at least one Sampled-with-output, a new reservation retires the least-recently-sampled output and a later read of it reports Retired | capacity test at 64 and 65 receipts mixing states | with 64 unsampled receipts the 65th opted-in exec_command is refused before any process is spawned (assert no child process / no process-store entry) with a structured error |
| 5 | Terminal stdin output and the pushed completion share one claim: the first lease (TerminalStdinOutput or PushedCompletion) consumes it | test racing write_stdin terminal output against the pushed-completion lease | the loser gets AlreadyConsumed / AlreadyLeased and produces no second completion |
| 6 | Cancellation hooks: explicit release cancels with Released and keeps the process running; terminate_process, interrupt and terminate_all_processes cancel with OwnerStopped / Interrupted / Shutdown before the process is killed | tests per path through the process manager | after release the later exit queues nothing; release of an unknown or foreign receipt is refused; a cancelled receipt cannot be leased |
| 7 | Default (not opted-in) launches are unchanged: no receipt reserved, identical exec_command / write_stdin responses, ExecCommandEnd events and pruning | existing unified_exec unit and core suite tests unchanged, plus a test launching more than 64 default processes over time | default launches never consume receipt capacity |

Top finding: precheck 1's 4th failure was not a Landlock issue — the CI log shows `terminal_stdin_claim_consumes_the_single_claim_first` panicking at `receipt_hooks_tests.rs:1231` with `Queued` vs expected `Sampled { TerminalStdinOutput }`. Root cause was a leaf ordering bug: `refresh_process_state` unbound the receipt before `write_stdin`'s terminal branches could claim through the binding, so the stdin claim always no-oped (deterministic on every platform; these tests had never run before precheck 1).

Changes (both inside `codex-rs/core/src/unified_exec/`, left uncommitted, HEAD untouched):

- [process_manager.rs](/Users/iv/Developer/IV/codex/.temp/STORY-260929-wg1ya0/worktree/codex-rs/core/src/unified_exec/process_manager.rs): `refresh_process_state` no longer unbinds; the `write_stdin` `Exited` and `Unknown`-but-exited branches now claim first, then unbind. `exec_command` inline paths already settle by receipt id, and default launches never bind, so nothing else changes.
- [receipt_hooks_tests.rs](/Users/iv/Developer/IV/codex/.temp/STORY-260929-wg1ya0/worktree/codex-rs/core/src/unified_exec/receipt_hooks_tests.rs): `hook_test_session` sets `config.codex_linux_sandbox_exe` on Linux via the existing `core_test_support::find_codex_linux_sandbox_exe()` helper (same one the integration harness and `guardian_tests.rs` use), with `expect` so it fails loudly rather than skipping. No-op on macOS/Windows; tests still drive production `exec_command`/`write_stdin`.

- `just fmt` → exit 0; `just clippy -p codex-core` → exit 0, 0 errors (only the 3 pre-existing out-of-scope warnings, untouched).
- All 16 mutant patches re-verified with `git apply --check` against the reworked tree: 16/16 OK, content unchanged (kept all 16, including the 3 undemonstrated in precheck 1).
